title: The Leaked Question Paper
briefing_md:
Friday's Data Structures exam paper appeared as a photo in the class WhatsApp group at 8:05 PM on Thursday, the night before the exam.

The paper had been sealed in a steel cupboard in Room 204, the department office. The Dean wants the leaker found before morning.

Three people are being talked about:
• Rohan Verma, 24, the teaching assistant. He can enter Room 204 during the day. He says he left at 5 PM and was in the library until about 8:45.
• Nisha Rao, 20, the class representative and topper. She says she collected lab files with the professor at 6:50 and they left together.
• Gopal Bhatia, 55, the department clerk for 20 years. He says he left at 5:30.

Most students suspect Rohan, the teaching assistant. Who leaked the paper?

clue.label: The leaked photo
clue.title: What the photo shows
clue.text:
The photo shows the question paper lying on a desk.
Question 4 has a correction in red ink: “5 marks” changed to “6 marks”.

Prof. Anita Kapoor: “I made that correction in red pen at 6:30 PM.”

questions.question: What does the red-ink correction rule out?
options: That the photo was taken at any time before 6:30 PM
That the photo was taken inside the department office
That a student was the one who posted the photo
That the paper was ever locked in the cupboard

clue.label: Steel cupboard
clue.title: The cupboard in Room 204
clue.text:
• No scratches. The lock is not forced.
• Prof. Kapoor: “I locked the paper in the cupboard at 6:45 PM.”
• On Friday morning the paper was in its envelope in the cupboard, and the cupboard was locked.

questions.question: What does this tell us about the leaker?
options: They forced the cupboard open and then repaired the lock
They used a key, and locked the paper away again afterwards
They photographed the paper through a gap in the cupboard door
They took the paper home and brought it back in the morning

clue.label: Keys
clue.title: Who holds a key
clue.text: Prof. Kapoor: “There are two keys. Mine was in my handbag all night, at home. The spare stays in Mr. Bhatia's desk drawer in Room 204. The drawer is not locked.”

questions.question: After 6:45 PM, who could have opened the cupboard?
options: Only Prof. Kapoor, because she alone carries a key to that cupboard
Only Mr. Bhatia, because the spare key is his
Any student of the class, at any time that evening
Anyone who got into Room 204 and knew about the drawer

clue.label: Library log
clue.title: Rohan's evening
clue.text:
Rohan Verma — IN 5:10 PM, OUT 8:45 PM.
The librarian confirms he did not leave.

The photo was posted at 8:05 PM.

questions.question: Rohan can enter Room 204. Why does that not make him the leaker?
options: The photo was taken after 6:30 PM, when he was in the library
Teaching assistants are never shown the exam papers
He had already gone home from the campus at 5:00 PM
The library does not allow phones or cameras inside the reading room

clue.label: Professor's statement
clue.title: Nisha's evening
clue.text: Prof. Kapoor: “Nisha came at 6:50 to collect lab files. She was with me the whole time. We left together at 7:10. The paper was already locked away at 6:45.”

questions.question: Nisha was in Room 204 that evening. What actually clears her?
options: She is the class topper, so she has no need to see the paper before the exam
The paper was locked before she came, and she was never there alone
She left Room 204 before the red-ink correction was made
She was only there to collect lab files, not exam papers

clue.label: Mugs
clue.title: A mug in the photo
clue.text:
• In the background of the leaked photo: a chipped green mug on top of the steel cupboard.
• Rohan's mug is blue and has his name on it.

questions.question: What does the background of the photo tell us?
options: It was taken in the library, and the mug belongs to Rohan
It was taken at the professor's home, where she kept her key
It was taken in Room 204, and the green mug's owner is worth finding
It was edited, because nobody keeps a mug on top of a cupboard

clue.label: WhatsApp group
clue.title: Who posted it
clue.text:
The photo was first posted at 8:05 PM by “Aman B.”, a student in the class.
Aman has no key to Room 204 or to the cupboard.
On Aman's phone the photo arrived as a forwarded image at 8:01 PM. The chat it came from has been deleted.

questions.question: What is the most reasonable reading of this?
options: Aman went into Room 204 himself and photographed the paper on the desk
The professor sent the paper to the class group by mistake
The photo was taken days earlier and only posted on Thursday
Someone with access took it and sent it to Aman just before 8:01

clue.label: Timeline
clue.title: Thursday evening
clue.text:
6:30 PM — red-ink correction made
6:45 PM — paper locked in the cupboard
7:10 PM — Prof. Kapoor and Nisha leave Room 204
8:01 PM — photo reaches Aman's phone
8:05 PM — photo posted in the class group

Prof. Kapoor: “From 6:30 until I locked it away, the paper never left my hands.”

questions.question: Using every time you know, when was the photo taken?
options: Between 6:30 PM and 6:45 PM, before it was locked
Between 6:45 PM and 7:10 PM
Between 7:10 PM and 8:01 PM
Between 8:01 PM and 8:05 PM

twist_md: New evidence has come in: the department visitor register, the clerk's desk, and a remark about the green mug.

clue.label: Visitor register
clue.title: Room 204, Thursday
clue.text:
Bhatia — OUT 5:30 PM
Nisha — IN 6:50 PM, OUT 7:10 PM
Bhatia — IN 7:40 PM, OUT 8:10 PM
The corridor guard: “Nobody else went in after 7:10.”

Bhatia: “I came back at 7:40 only for my tiffin box and left.”

Next morning the tiffin box is still on his desk, unopened.

twist_questions.question: Which two facts break Bhatia's story?
options: He signed the register, and the corridor guard saw him
He stayed 30 minutes for a one-minute errand, and the tiffin never left
He left at 5:30 PM, and Nisha arrived at 6:50 PM
He came back after the professor had gone, and he left at 8:10 PM

clue.label: Desk drawer
clue.title: Inside the clerk's drawer
clue.text:
• The spare cupboard key, on a tag.
• Under it, a college notice: “Backlog list: Aman Bhatia, Data Structures, 2nd attempt.”

Aman is Mr. Bhatia's son.

twist_questions.question: Which earlier clue becomes far more important now?
options: The post by “Aman B.” at 8:05 PM
Rohan's library log
The red-ink correction
Nisha's lab files

clue.label: The green mug
clue.title: Whose mug is it?
clue.text:
Rohan: “Everyone knows the chipped green mug is Bhatia sir's.”

The photo reached Aman at 8:01 PM. Bhatia was inside Room 204 from 7:40 to 8:10 PM, and nobody else went in after 7:10.

twist_questions.question: What most likely happened?
options: Rohan took the photo earlier in the day and kept it to put the blame on Bhatia
Aman slipped into Room 204 and took the spare key from the drawer
Nisha came back alone with the professor's key after 7:10 PM
Bhatia opened the cupboard with the spare key and sent his son the photo

answer.explanation: Gopal Bhatia, the clerk, came back to Room 204 at 7:40 PM, opened the cupboard with the spare key from his drawer, photographed the paper and sent it to his son Aman, who has a backlog in the same subject. The photo reached Aman at 8:01 PM and he posted it at 8:05 PM. The red-ink correction proves the photo was taken after 6:30 PM, the cupboard was not forced and was locked again, and Bhatia's green mug is in the photo. His “I only came for my tiffin” story is false: he stayed 30 minutes, the tiffin was still on his desk next morning, and nobody else entered after 7:10. Rohan was in the library from 5:10 to 8:45, and Nisha was with the professor the whole time.
